mapper.sql: id, item_no, owner_id, title, cover, images, cat_l1, cat_l2, condition_level, est_value, want_cats, want_desc, accept_any, delivery_mode, city, location, description, status, reject_reason, view_count, offer_count, swap_count, hot_score, publish_time, create_by, create_time, update_time, tenant_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO twelve_exchange_item (item_no, owner_id, title, cover, images, cat_l1, cat_l2, condition_level, est_value, want_cats, want_desc, accept_any, delivery_mode, city, location, description, status, create_by, create_time, update_time, tenant_id) VALUES (#{itemNo}, #{ownerId}, #{title}, #{cover}, #{images}, #{catL1}, #{catL2}, #{conditionLevel}, #{estValue}, #{wantCats}, #{wantDesc}, #{acceptAny}, #{deliveryMode}, #{city}, #{location}, #{description}, #{status}, #{createBy}, NOW(), NOW(), #{tenantId})
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM twelve_exchange_item
ORDER BY hot_score DESC, publish_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
mapper.update: UPDATE twelve_exchange_item SET status = 'locked', update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{itemId} AND owner_id = #{ownerId} AND status = 'onswap' AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}
UPDATE twelve_exchange_item SET status = 'onswap', update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{itemId} AND status = 'locked' AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}
UPDATE twelve_exchange_item SET status = 'swapped', swap_count = swap_count + 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{itemId} AND status = 'locked' AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}

where.if: AND (i.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR i.item_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.select:
SELECT i.*, u.nick_name AS owner_name FROM twelve_exchange_item i LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = i.owner_id
ORDER BY CASE WHEN i.status = 'auditing' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, i.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
mapper.update: UPDATE twelve_exchange_item SET status = 'onswap', publish_time = NOW(), update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{itemId} AND status = 'auditing' AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}
UPDATE twelve_exchange_item SET status = 'rejected', reject_reason = #{reason}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{itemId} AND status = 'auditing' AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}
mapper.select: SELECT i.*, u.nick_name AS owner_name FROM twelve_exchange_item i LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = i.owner_id WHERE i.status = 'onswap' AND i.id IN #{id} AND i.tenant_id = #{tenantId}
SELECT id AS itemId, tenant_id AS tenantId, owner_id AS ownerId, title FROM twelve_exchange_item WHERE status = 'onswap' ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalItems, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'onswap' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS onswapCount, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'locked' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lockedCount, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'swapped' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS swappedCount, SUM(view_count) AS sumViewCount FROM twelve_exchange_item
tenant_id = #{tenantId}
SELECT cat_l1 AS catL1, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM twelve_exchange_item WHERE status IN ('onswap', 'locked', 'swapped') AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} GROUP BY cat_l1 ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT #{limit}
